en: A black‑and‑white view of a two‑storey mansion or small castle in a park-like setting. The building has a symmetrical facade with rectangular windows, decorative cornices, and a small balcony. On the right side stands a short, crenellated tower with Gothic‑revival details. The house is surrounded by lush trees and a garden with low shrubs, while a curved path leads toward the entrance.
